title: xmlUtils helpers duplicated in api/search/mexicana.js Edge route
detail: src/adapters/_shared/xmlUtils.js cannot be imported by api/search/mexicana.js (Vercel Edge route, cross-import constraint). The DC/OAI helpers are inlined in mexicana.js. Fix: move xmlUtils.js to a packages/shared-utils workspace package importable by both sides. Estimated effort: 2h (extract, add package.json, update imports). Risk: low (pure functions, no side effects).

title: parseOpenAlexWork already shared between OPENALEX and CURATED adapters
detail: parseOpenAlexWork is correctly extracted to _shared/parseOpenAlex.js and imported by both OPENALEX and CURATED. OA_SELECT is the SSOT for the select= field list. This is the exemplary pattern to follow for future adapters that share an upstream API.

title: try-direct-fetch-then-proxiedFetch pattern repeated across 3 adapters
detail: Northwestern (northwestern.js:27-30), ONB (onb.js:26-29), and BnF Catalogue (bnfApi.js:28-31) all implement the same pattern: try direct fetch(), catch network error, fall back to proxiedFetch(). This produces a silent CORS network error in the browser on every call before the proxy leg succeeds. The pattern should be replaced by the proxiedFetch() branch check (typeof window === 'undefined') that already exists in proxy.js. Estimated effort: 30 min per adapter. Risk: low.

title: Thin-shim adapters lack capability metadata needed by coverage engine
detail: Six thin-shim adapters (Gallica, OpenContext, BDH, BritishLibrary, OpenEdition, Mexicana) are missing serverSafe and/or corpusSize in their capability objects. The coverage engine cannot weight their contribution and the ranker cannot include them in the server fan-out. Add serverSafe: false (they route through backend), and realistic corpusSize estimates. Effort: 15 min each.

title: Dead adapters (SCIELO, OPENNEURO, ENA) registered in ADAPTERS array inflate partial coverage
detail: SCIELO, OPENNEURO, and ENA are in the ADAPTERS array (index.js:69,87,88) but always return 0 results. Every search through /api/search counts them as failing sources, causing the coverage engine to report partial coverage and apply a billing discount on every query. Remove from ADAPTERS array; keep the source files. Effort: 5 min + coverage test verification.

title: proxiedFetch spoof headers duplicated between proxy.js and api/proxy.js
detail: proxy.js:19-24 and api/proxy.js:69-73 define the same browser-spoof header set (User-Agent, Accept, Accept-Language, Referer). Constraint is documented: src/ and api/ cannot cross-import. Same fix as R-100: shared package. Until then, any change to the spoof headers must be applied in both files.
